verdict.rationale: Inngest ships built-in observability (metrics, traces, event logs, per-step timing) without manual instrumentation, and its AI Overview dashboard is explicitly built on OpenTelemetry-derived metadata, implying some OTel compatibility. However there is no documented mechanism for exporting failure-rate/latency/queue-depth metrics to an external observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) nor any alerting/webhook capability tied to workflow health thresholds. Missing for 10: explicit metrics/traces export integration to third-party observability platforms, and a documented alerting mechanism for misbehaving workflows.
